entities.summary: Beverley Jane Glover is a British biologist specialising in botany. Since July 2013, she has been Professor of Plant Systematics and Evolution in the Department of Plant Sciences at the University of Cambridge and director of the Cambridge University Botanic Garden. Beverley Glover was a logicians & mathematicians from United Kingdom (b. 1972-03-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
